questions.cardText:
[Political Science] What does the political theory “liberalism” primarily advocate for?
A. A state-controlled economy
B. Individual rights and freedoms
C. The abolition of government
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wofür tritt die politische Theorie des Liberalismus in erster Linie ein?
questions.en: What does the political theory of liberalism primarily advocate?

timeline.labelEn: John Locke's Two Treatises of Government, often seen as founding liberalism, is published
timeline.labelDe: John Lockes „Zwei Abhandlungen über die Regierung“, oft als Gründungstext des Liberalismus gesehen, erscheinen

questions.notes: Timeline month (December 1689, dated 1690) from the Two Treatises of Government article.

questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Invention] How do Liquid Crystal Displays (LCDs) work?
A. By manipulating the alignment of liquid crystals
B. By using organic light-emitting diodes
C. By refracting light through a semiconductor layer
Answer: A. LCDs work by changing the orientation of liquid crystals. These crystals control the passage of light from a backlight. By altering the alignment of the crystals, LCDs can change how light passes through them, creating the images you see on the screen.
questions.de: Was verändern Flüssigkristallbildschirme (LCDs) an ihren Flüssigkristallen, um das Licht der Hintergrundbeleuchtung zu steuern und ein Bild zu erzeugen?
questions.en: What do liquid-crystal displays (LCDs) change about their liquid crystals to control the light from a backlight and form an image?

timeline.labelEn: George H. Heilmeier's team at RCA presents the first operational liquid-crystal display
timeline.labelDe: George H. Heilmeiers Team bei RCA stellt den ersten funktionsfähigen Flüssigkristallbildschirm vor

questions.notes: LCDs combine liquid crystals with polarizers; the crystals emit no light themselves (Wikipedia).
